Name: Farmer's Collective
Author: mekkanikmike
Description:
Sick and tired of having only one place to get your farming needs satisfied? Hate buying from that Goblin Morris, or that son of a filthy half-troll rat eating munge bucket, Pierre? Well, looks like dear departed Grandpa has started a farmer's collective in Ferngill. And they are only too happy to help out.

What do you get?

A starter's kit containing mixed seeds, and a scarecrow. And a couple of seed makers. And a couple of crops of each type. You don't get all the spring crops on Day 1. You have to get a little better at farming. You also get a load out at the start of each season in years 1 & 2. Two of each seasonal crop to put in your seed maker. You also get rewarded with a tree sapling each time your farming skill levels up. So go on, Stick a finger in Pierre's eye, and one in Morris' as well.

[spoiler]
What do you get?

Spring, year 1.
Day 1: one scarecrow, 30 mixed seeds, and 2 each of green bean, seed maker.
Day 7: Robin gives you some sprinklers
Day 28: you get five garden pots.

Summer, Fall of year 1: Starter pack of two each of all summer crops along with 30 mixed seed. Crops that can be spawned by mixed seeds are not sent in.
spring, summer, fall year 2: Two each of year two crops.

Levelling rewards:
Level 1: Rest of spring year 1 crops.
Level 3: Cherry sapling
Level 4: Apricot sapling
Level 5: Orange sapling
Level 6: Peach sapling
Level 7: Apple sapling
Level 8: Pomegranate sapling.

[/spoiler]
